tgoneconfig.hud.tour.welcome.title: Welcome to the HUD editor
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.welcome.body: This is where you place and style your HUDs. Here's a quick tour of the basics.
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.adding.title: Add HUDs
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.adding.body: Click a HUD in the library to drop it in the middle of the screen, or drag it to where you want it. Most HUDs can be added more than once, each with its own settings.
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.dragging.title: Move and resize
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.dragging.body: Drag a HUD to move it. It snaps to the screen edges and other HUDs. Hold Alt to place it freely. Drag a corner to resize it. Drag across empty space to select several HUDs at once.
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.merging.title: Merge HUDs
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.merging.body: Stack HUDs on top of each other, or put them side by side, and their backgrounds merge into one shape. Drag any of them to move the merged HUDs together. To pull one out, click it first, then drag it away.
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.merging.task: Try it: stack a HUD right above or below another one until their backgrounds merge.
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.merging.task_add: Try it: add another text HUD from the library, then stack it right above or below the first one.
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.anchoring.title: Anchor HUDs
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.anchoring.body: Right-click a HUD to open this menu, then pick Anchor. Click a point on your HUD, then a point on another HUD. It will now follow that HUD wherever it moves.
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.settings.title: Settings
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.settings.body: Click a HUD to open this panel. The Settings tab holds the HUD's own options and where it shows up.
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.style.title: Style
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.style.body: The Style tab changes how the HUD looks: its text, colours, shadow and background, including merging.
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.fonts.title: Fonts and text
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.fonts.body: In Style, the Text section lets you switch between the Minecraft and Poppins fonts, and change the size, weight, style and case.
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.layout.title: Layout
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.layout.body: The Layout tab covers position, scale, size, alignment and padding.
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.done.title: You're all set
tgoneconfig.hud.tour.done.body: Right-click empty space and pick Editor Tour to see this again.
